items.headline: Marine Weather Statement issued November 21 at 6:08AM CST by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
items.area: Matagorda Bay; Galveston Bay; Coastal waters from Freeport to Matagorda Ship Channel TX out 20 NM; Coastal waters from High Island to Freeport TX out 20 NM
items.description:
Areas of dense fog are occurring over inland areas. We cannot rule
out fog occasionally impacting the bays and the beaches through
about mid morning. Any fog impacts to marine areas are expected to
be short lived.
